name: CyTools_VideoStudio
description: Desktop video studio for AI generation, ComfyUI workflows, motion design, RTX/DLSS upscaling, stereo 3D and Gaussian splats. Built on CyToolsCore with MCP, SDK and CLI access.

operations.name: MiniMax H3 - Generate video (MiniMax H3-Base)
operations.description: Generate a 4-15 s video with its stereo sound on the GPU bridge: text only (T2VA), from a first and/or last frame (FL2VA), from references (Ref2VA), with timed guides and an optional ControlNet video. Local files are uploaded automatically; the result MP4 and its last frame are returned.

task.description: t2va = text only; fl2va = first and/or last frame (set automatically when a frame is given); ref2va = omni-reference (set automatically when references or a control video are given).

prompt.description: What happens, shot by shot. H3 follows its prompt guide best: integrated_multimodal_description / overall_soundscape / non_diegetic_music; dialogue as <d>[English] line</d>.

duration.description: Seconds (4-15). Snapped up to the 17k+5 frame grid at 24 fps.

aspect.description: auto follows the first/last frame, else 16:9.

short_edge.description: Short edge in pixels. 768 is the trained size; 544 is about 2x faster for drafts.

seed.description: -1 draws a random seed (reported in the outputs).

steps.description: Denoising steps. Default 20 (base), 4 or 8 with a turbo LoRA.

first_frame.description: Image the video starts from (FL2VA). Absolute paths are imported automatically.

guides.description: Timed anchors: an image, a short clip, an audio clip or a clip with its sound pinned at a time of the video (negative times count from the end).

references.description: Ref2VA references, in the order the prompt names them (<Picture 1>, <Video 1>, <Audio 1>): at most 9 images, 3 videos, 3 audio clips, 12 files in total.

file.description: Reference video (2-15 s, re-timed to 24 fps).

ref_image_size.description: match = reference images at the canvas area; max = up to 2048 px.

control.description: Fun ControlNet Union: guide the motion with a depth, pose, HED, MLSD or Canny video (or colour video + preprocess canny), or inpaint with a mask video.

video.description: Control video (resized to the canvas, 24 fps).

acceleration.description: none = H3-Base as released; turbo4/turbo8 = lightx2v distillation LoRAs.

loras.description: Extra LoRA files present in the bridge LoRA folder.

precision.description: Weights precision; auto follows the GPU profile of the bridge.

text_encoder_device.description: cpu keeps the 32B text encoder off small GPUs (slow).

crf.description: H.264 quality of the output (lower = better). Empty = ComfyUI default.

connection.description: Named bridge connection; empty = default connection.

output_name.description: File name of the result inside the job.

workflow.description: Workflow file (absolute path or name in data/workflows) or object.

connection.description: Named bridge connection; empty = default connection.

operations.name: MiniMax H3 - Generate from an Unreal scene
operations.description: Turn a scene package exported by the CyMiniMaxH3 Unreal plugin (scene.json + renders) into a workflow and run it: one generation per shot, camera path and dialogue written into the prompts, keyframes and control passes from the scene, then one film.

scene.description: Folder (or scene.json) exported by the Unreal plugin.

chain.description: Start each shot from the previous generated last frame.

use_interpretation.description: Use the prompts of interpretation.json (rules, LLM rewrite or your edits) when it matches this export.

rewrite.description: none = rules only; llm = rewrite the rules text with an LLM (checked).

provider.description: LLM provider id (list_llm_providers); empty = the one chosen in the application.

instructions.description: Extra direction for the rewrite (tone, genre, era...).

memory.description: Spatial memory: reuse frames of earlier shots that saw the same place as references (and as first frame when the camera returns to almost the same framing). Default from scene.json, else references.

memory_characters.description: Reuse the best earlier view of characters without a reference image.

connection.description: Named bridge connection; empty = default connection.

operations.name: MiniMax H3 - Generate a multi-segment film
operations.description: Generate a whole film planned by CyTools Storyboard (film.json): one MiniMax H3 segment per panel, each starting on the previous segment's last frames so places, characters, light and sound continue across cuts (Timeline Director Drift-Control), rendered segment by segment to disk on the GPU. Unchanged segments of earlier runs of the same film are reused: an interrupted film resumes, an edited segment re-samples only itself and what follows.

film.description: film.json exported by CyTools Storyboard (or its folder); its pictures sit next to it.

model.description: community_turbo8: MATLOWAI fused turbo int8 transformer (8 steps, int8 GPUs); official: Comfy-Org Ref2VA transformer at the profile precision (20 steps).

segment_seeds.description: Other seeds for some segments: {"3": 1234} or "3:1234, 5:99"; the following segments are re-sampled.

second_pass.description: SelfLift two-stage sampling; null = from the film.

reuse.description: Reuse the unchanged finished segments of earlier runs of this film on the GPU machine (resume, re-take).

film_name.description: Name of the film on the GPU machine (default: title); runs of the same name share their segments.

connection.description: Named bridge connection; empty = default connection.

output_name.description: File name of the result inside the job.

operations.name: MiniMax H3 - Check a multi-segment film
operations.description: Check a film.json with the same rules as the GPU side (segment windows on the 5 + 17n grid, overlaps, pictures) and summarise it: segments, real durations, prompts, estimated time. Uploads nothing.

operations.name: Stereo 3D - Convert to stereoscopic 3D
operations.description: Convert a 2D video into a stereoscopic 3D video: temporally consistent depth, disparity, synthesis of the opposite view, disocclusion filling, optional upscaling and packing into a VR compatible file.

video_file.description: Source video. An absolute path anywhere the Tool process can read is accepted and copied into the private job workspace automatically; a relative name is resolved from CYTOOLS_STEREO3D_INPUT_ROOT (data/inputs by default). MP4, MKV, MOV, WEBM, AVI.

start_seconds.description: Skip this many seconds of the source before converting.

duration_seconds.description: Length to convert, in seconds. Null converts to the end of the source.

frame_limit.description: Hard stop after this many converted frames. 0 means no limit.

quality_preset.description: Fills every parameter left null with a coherent set of values. An explicit value is never overwritten.

write_depth_preview.description: Also write a grayscale depth video next to the result.

write_anaglyph_preview.description: Also write a short red/cyan preview, useful to check the depth without a headset.

preview_seconds.description: Length of the previews, in seconds.

keep_intermediate.description: Keep the per-eye videos and the depth data in the job workspace instead of removing them after packing.

output_format.description: Packing of the two eyes in the result.

labels.sbs_half: Side-by-Side half width (most common for VR players)
labels.sbs_full: Side-by-Side full width (two full frames, widest file)
labels.anaglyph_red_cyan: Single red/cyan file, for checking depth without a headset

eye_mode.description: symmetric synthesises both eyes from the source and halves the size of the disoccluded areas, which is the cleanest result. right_only keeps the source as the left eye, which preserves it untouched.

depth_strength.description: Multiplier on the whole disparity budget. 0 produces a flat image, 1 is the calibrated value.

max_disparity_percent.description: Disparity budget as a percentage of the frame width, before the comfort cap. 2.5 percent of a 1920 wide frame is 48 pixels.

convergence.description: Normalised depth placed on the screen plane. Everything nearer comes out of the screen, everything farther sits behind it.

depth_floor.description: Normalised depth below which everything is flattened onto the far plane.

depth_ceiling.description: Normalised depth above which everything is flattened onto the near plane.

disparity_gamma.description: Shapes the depth-to-disparity curve. Below 1 gives more separation to distant planes, above 1 concentrates it on the foreground.

comfort_mode.description: Hard cap applied to the disparity: standard caps it at 3 percent of the width, strict at 1.8 percent, off at 8 percent.

supersample_factor.description: Horizontal subpixel factor used while splatting. Higher removes aliasing along vertical edges. Null follows quality_preset.

depth_sharpness.description: Edge-aware sharpening of the depth map against the colour frame before warping. Higher keeps object borders crisp and reduces halos.

splat_softness.description: How strongly a nearer sample wins over a farther one in the soft z-buffer. Higher is a harder occlusion decision.

depth_encoder.description: Video Depth Anything backbone. vits is Apache-2.0 and fast; vitb and vitl are CC-BY-NC-4.0 and sharper. Null follows quality_preset.

depth_input_size.description: Shorter side fed to the depth network, on the 14 pixel patch grid. Larger recovers finer structure and costs VRAM. Null follows quality_preset.

depth_max_resolution.description: The depth network never sees a side longer than this; the depth map is then resampled to the working size.

depth_window_frames.description: Frames in one temporal window of the depth network. The upstream model is trained for 32. Null follows quality_preset.

segment_frames.description: Frames processed per pipeline segment. Lower bounds the RAM used by decoding and by the temporal inpainting search.

segment_overlap.description: Frames shared by two consecutive segments, used to align their depth scale so the stereo does not jump.

temporal_strength.description: Strength of the temporal filter applied to the depth sequence. Higher removes flicker, too high smears depth during fast motion. Null follows quality_preset.

scene_cut_threshold.description: Mean absolute frame difference above which a cut is declared. A cut resets the temporal filter and the depth alignment. 0 disables cut detection.

normalization.description: How the relative depth is mapped to a fixed range. global reads the whole clip first and is the most stable; progressive freezes the range after a warm-up and suits long files; auto picks global for short clips.

depth_percentile_low.description: Low percentile of the depth histogram mapped to the far plane, which rejects outliers.

depth_percentile_high.description: High percentile mapped to the near plane.

inpainting_backend.description: classical fills the disoccluded areas from real background pixels of neighbouring frames and then from the local background. stereocrafter hands the splatted frames to the StereoCrafter diffusion model, which must be installed.

inpainting_quality.description: fast fills from the nearest background edge; balanced adds a guided diffusion of the filled area; high first searches real background pixels in neighbouring frames. Null follows quality_preset.

background_search_frames.description: How many frames before and after are searched for the real background of a disoccluded area. 0 disables the search. Null follows quality_preset.

occlusion_dilate.description: Pixels by which the hole mask is grown before filling, which removes the smeared border left by the warp. Null follows quality_preset.

hole_feather.description: Width of the blend between filled and original pixels.

external_output_layout.description: How the result of an external backend is arranged. auto measures it against the source size. Ignored by the native backend.

scene_prompt.description: Short description of the scene. Only the StereoPilot backend uses it; upstream requires one text file per clip. Ignored by the native backend.

consistency_threshold.description: Maximum photometric error accepted when a neighbouring frame is used as background. Lower refuses more candidates and falls back to the local fill.

upscale_enabled.description: Run the Real-ESRGAN upscaler inside the pipeline.

upscale_model.description: Upscaler weights. x2plus doubles, x4plus quadruples, anime is for drawn content. Each must be installed from the Models screen.

upscale_stage.description: before_stereo upscales the source so the depth network sees more detail and costs more VRAM; after_stereo upscales each finished eye, which is faster and never invents detail the depth used.

upscale_tile.description: Tile size used by the upscaler. 0 processes the whole frame at once and needs much more VRAM.

upscale_tile_overlap.description: Overlap between upscaler tiles, which removes their seams.

target_resolution.description: Final per-eye picture size. source keeps the source size, or the upscaled size when the upscaler is enabled.

target_width.description: Per-eye width used when target_resolution is custom.

target_height.description: Per-eye height used when target_resolution is custom.

resize_mode.description: fit keeps the aspect ratio inside the target, cover fills it and crops, stretch ignores the ratio.

container.description: File container. mkv carries a real stereo layout tag; mp4 is the most widely accepted by headsets and players.

video_codec.description: Video encoder. The NVENC entries need a supported NVIDIA GPU and an ffmpeg build that exposes them; diagnose_backend lists what is actually available. ffv1 is lossless and very large.

quality_crf.description: Quality for the software encoders (CRF): lower is better and larger. Used as CQ for the NVENC encoders and ignored by ffv1.

encoder_preset.description: Speed/size trade-off passed to the encoder.

encoder_threads.description: Frame threads of the software encoders. 0 lets ffmpeg choose from the core count, which at a large frame size makes one encoder hold several gigabytes of buffers. The default bounds that without slowing the pipeline, whose cost is the depth and the warp, not the encoding.

pixel_format.description: Chroma layout of the encoded file. yuv420p is the compatible choice for headsets.

output_fps.description: Frame rate of the output. Null keeps the source rate. Frames are not interpolated: a different rate only changes the timing metadata and frame selection.

copy_audio.description: Copy the first audio track of the source into the result when the container accepts it.

operations.name: Stereo 3D - Estimate video depth
operations.description: Run only the temporally consistent depth stage and export the depth as a video and, optionally, as float16 arrays that another Tool can consume.

video_file.description: Source video. An absolute path anywhere the Tool process can read is accepted and copied into the private job workspace automatically; a relative name is resolved from CYTOOLS_STEREO3D_INPUT_ROOT (data/inputs by default). MP4, MKV, MOV, WEBM, AVI.

depth_encoder.description: Video Depth Anything backbone. vits is Apache-2.0 and fast; vitb and vitl are CC-BY-NC-4.0 and sharper. Null follows quality_preset.

depth_input_size.description: Shorter side fed to the depth network, on the 14 pixel patch grid. Larger recovers finer structure and costs VRAM. Null follows quality_preset.

depth_max_resolution.description: The depth network never sees a side longer than this; the depth map is then resampled to the working size.

depth_window_frames.description: Frames in one temporal window of the depth network. The upstream model is trained for 32. Null follows quality_preset.

segment_frames.description: Frames processed per pipeline segment. Lower bounds the RAM used by decoding and by the temporal inpainting search.

segment_overlap.description: Frames shared by two consecutive segments, used to align their depth scale so the stereo does not jump.

temporal_strength.description: Strength of the temporal filter applied to the depth sequence. Higher removes flicker, too high smears depth during fast motion. Null follows quality_preset.

scene_cut_threshold.description: Mean absolute frame difference above which a cut is declared. A cut resets the temporal filter and the depth alignment. 0 disables cut detection.

normalization.description: How the relative depth is mapped to a fixed range. global reads the whole clip first and is the most stable; progressive freezes the range after a warm-up and suits long files; auto picks global for short clips.

depth_percentile_low.description: Low percentile of the depth histogram mapped to the far plane, which rejects outliers.

depth_percentile_high.description: High percentile mapped to the near plane.

quality_preset.description: Fills every parameter left null with a coherent set of values. An explicit value is never overwritten.
